name: Equinix MC1 Muscat IBX (physical site Barka, Al Batinah South)
notes: MC1 opened Oct 2020; 23,600 sq ft, 725 cabinets expandable to 2,150; carrier-neutral hub; OAC lands directly into MC1; OEG cable (du+Omantel) connects MC1. Datacenters.com places physical site in Barka, Al Batinah South Governorate (metro label 'Muscat MC1' retained). MW not disclosed.

name: Ooredoo (Syntys) Barka data centre + 2Africa landing
notes: 2022 groundbreaking for Barka Tier 3 DC (>500 racks planned) with 2Africa cable landing role; datacenterHawk lists Syntys (Ooredoo) Barka location. Official Ooredoo launch release not found for Barka - launch status unverified; keep construction/lead.

name: Omantel Blue City data centre (Barka)
notes: Directory-listed Omantel-operated data centre in Barka. No primary Omantel facility page or MW found - C-grade directory lead.

name: Oman Digital Triangle - Barka digital hub / AI super-cluster node
developer: Sultanate of Oman MTCIT / International Data Center Authority (IDCA)
notes: National Oman Digital Triangle agreement (Sept 2025) covering three interconnected digital hubs/AI super-clusters (Barka, Duqm, Sur per COMEX 2025 coverage) with GW-scale ambitions. Planned/JDA level - no land/permit/site per node; do not count as supply.

name: Ooredoo Sohar data centre
notes: Launched 3 Nov 2024; 1,200 racks, up to 10 MW power supply, Level 3+/Tier III standards (operator claim, not Uptime-certified per methodology). Located Sohar, Al Batinah North.

name: Green Data City Sohar Free Zone data computing centre
developer: Green Data City (Sohar Port and Freezone land lease)
notes: Sohar Port and Freezone signed land-lease agreement (Jan 2024) with Green Data City for ~US$210m data computing centre providing hosting, processing and data mining in the free zone per ONA/AGBI. Land/lease stage - planned.

name: Otech (Oman Data Park) Firq / Nizwa data centre
developer: Otech (Omantel), Oman Data Park; solar integrated
notes: Otech official newsroom: 'upcoming' state-of-the-art data center in Firq, Nizwa (Ad Dakhiliyah/Interior), purpose-built with solar infrastructure, total power output 4.4 MW, 500+ racks. Otech launch page referenced Farq DC. Status planned/upcoming per official wording; DCD (2025) calls it planned with ~350 kW solar at launch. First solar-powered green DC initiative in Oman (AI in Oman).

name: Datamount Al Jabal Al Akhdar data centre
notes: Datamount official site: multi-location strategy with facilities including Al Jabal al Akhdhar (Ad Dakhiliyah/Interior); W.Media/TechAfrica confirm Jabal Al Akhdhar as existing centre predating Al Bandar. Operator-claimed operational; capacity not disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Bawshar (Muscat) flagship Tier 3 data centre
notes: Bawshar/Muscat flagship launched March 2021; 2.5 MW, ~7,000 sqm, Tier 3, 99.982%+ availability claim (operator). Ooredoo official release confirms flagship facility in south of capital; serves Data2Cloud hosting.

name: Otech / Oman Data Park KOM4 data centre (Rusayl)
notes: KOM4, Knowledge Oasis Muscat, Rusayl (Zone 2, 7th floor); Tier 3, ~12,000 sq ft, ~192 racks per directory; MTCIT approved-provider register lists Oman Data Park/Otech with KOM4 address (A for accreditation/existence; rack count C). 1.4 MW onsite solar project reported (DCD 2025).

name: Oman Data Park Al Wattayah data centre
notes: ODP service page: three Level 3 in-country data centres - Al Wattayah, Rusayl and Duqm - linked for interconnection/business continuity. Wattayah = earlier ~12,000 sq ft facility west of Muscat (DCD). MW not disclosed.

name: Datamount Al Bandar Centre (Al Seeb)
notes: Al Bandar Centre, Al Seeb, Muscat Governorate; Tier III colocation/cloud/DR centre; capacity over 700 racks in phases (B, W.Media/Times of Oman); launched 2023-2024 era, currently listed active in directories. Datamount HQ at Al Bandar.

name: AWS Local Zone Muscat (me-south-1-mct-1a)
notes: AWS Local Zone in Oman (Muscat), code me-south-1-mct-1a, parent region Middle East (Bahrain) me-south-1. Available Local Zone - cloud edge node, NOT a full AWS Region; host facility undisclosed; do not count as colocation capacity.

name: OCI Dedicated Region - Muscat primary (Otech / ITHCA / Oracle)
notes: OCI Dedicated Region primary in Muscat (Otech/ITHCA/Oracle); dedicated/sovereign cloud infrastructure, not a generic public OCI region. Host facility is ODP/Otech Muscat infrastructure; separate from public cloud regions. Available/operational per operator.

name: Oman Digital Triangle - Sur digital hub / AI super-cluster node
developer: Sultanate of Oman MTCIT / International Data Center Authority (IDCA)
notes: Oman Digital Triangle places one of three planned nodes in Sur (Ash Sharqiyah South / Southeastern). Planned/JDA level; no land/permit/site disclosed.

name: Qalhat cable landing station (TGN-Gulf, SMW5)
notes: Qalhat (near Sur, Ash Sharqiyah South) cable landing station for TGN-Gulf and SMW5 systems. Connectivity-only infrastructure - no datacenter facility evidenced at this site; recorded to complete Southeastern division coverage.

name: Oman Data Park / Otech Duqm data centre (SEZAD)
notes: ODP Duqm data centre opened Feb 2018 (Tier 3, DCPost MEA); located SEZAD HQ building, Duqm, Al Wusta (Central); one of ODP's three linked Level 3 centres (Duqm, Wattayah, Muscat); hosts Port of Duqm Company DR infrastructure. A-grade operator/ODP listing; capacity not disclosed.

name: Oman Digital Triangle - Duqm digital hub / AI super-cluster node
developer: Sultanate of Oman MTCIT / International Data Center Authority (IDCA)
notes: Oman Digital Triangle places one of three planned nodes in Duqm (SEZAD/Al Wusta). Planned/JDA level; no land/permit/site per node disclosed.

name: Otech / ITHCA / Oracle OCI Secondary Dedicated Region - Ibri
developer: Otech (Omantel) / Oman Data Park; ITHCA Group; Oracle
notes: OCI Secondary Dedicated Region launched in Ibri (Ad Dhahirah) paired with Muscat primary for redundancy/data sovereignty (Otech official launch + ITHCA/Oracle partnership). Dedicated/sovereign cloud infrastructure; host facility not disclosed as standalone colo; MW not disclosed.

name: Equinix SN1 Salalah data centre (with Omantel)
notes: SN1 opened 7 Nov 2024 in Salalah (Janaif wilayat), Dhofar; second carrier-neutral IBX in Oman with Omantel; phase-two +125 racks greenlit for Q2 2025 (Equinix Q3 2024 results). OEG subsea cable also connects SN1. Rack count/IT MW not fully disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Salalah Data Centre and Submarine Cable Landing Station
notes: Inaugurated 17 Aug 2025 in Dhofar in presence of Governor of Dhofar; first combined DC+CLS in southern Oman; Tier 3/Class 3 compliant; launched with 125 racks scaling to 500 in phases; hosts 2Africa landing. IT MW not disclosed.

name: Exahertz International Salalah Free Zone data hosting / crypto mining centre (Asyad Group)
developer: Exahertz International (Afaq Advanced Technologies subsidiary), Asyad Group
notes: First phase inaugurated 13 Aug 2023 at Salalah Free Zone (ONA); ~US$348-370m data processing/crypto mining centre (Bitmain hardware per crypto press); DCD reports ~11 MW with three Salalah DCs + one at Al Jabal Al Akhdar planned. Crypto/data-hosting class - record separately from colocation; MW from DCD is B-grade.
